title: IBM Full Stack Software Developer Professional Certificate
description: A comprehensive program covering front-end and back-end development, cloud-native tools, databases, APIs, and DevOps practices, equipping learners to build and deploy full-stack applications.

title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024 Generative AI Certified Professional
description: Validates expertise in implementing and managing generative AI solutions using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, with focus on AI services, model deployment, and responsible AI practices.

title: Google Cloud - Associate Cloud Engineer Certification
description: Demonstrates proficiency in deploying, managing, and operating applications on Google Cloud. Certified professionals can use Google Cloud Console and CLI to maintain cloud infrastructure and ensure service reliability.

title: Computer Systems Servicing NC2
issuer: Technical Education and Skills Development Authority
description: A TESDA-certified qualification that trains individuals in installing, configuring, and troubleshooting computer systems and networks, performing maintenance, and supporting ICT services in accordance with industry standards.

title: Web Development NC3
issuer: Technical Education and Skills Development Authority
description: A TESDA-accredited certification focused on advanced web development skills, including designing, building, and maintaining dynamic and responsive websites and web applications using modern programming languages, frameworks, and best practices.

title: AWS Cloud Quest: Cloud Practitioner
description: An interactive, game-based learning certification from AWS that introduces foundational cloud concepts, core AWS services, billing, security, and cloud architecture basics through hands-on quests in a virtual environment.
